name: click-clarity-ai
description: Connect ChatGPT to your ClickClarity workspace over OAuth. Live Meta, Google Ads, GA4, Shopify, HubSpot, and Change Intelligence tools—read-only analytics for your connected accounts.

interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT to your ClickClarity workspace with OAuth. Query live Meta Ads, Google Ads, GA4, Shopify, HubSpot, and Change Intelligence data for the accounts you have already connected in ClickClarity. Read-only tools only—no ad account writes. Use the bundled analysis skills for diagnostics, cross-platform checks, and audits.
defaultPrompt: How did Meta and Google Ads perform last week?
Which campaigns drove the most conversions?
Summarize what changed in my ad accounts recently.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It only reads analytics already authorized in the user's ClickClarity workspace.

positive.description: Compare Meta and Google Ads performance for last week
positive.prompt: How did Meta and Google Ads perform last week?
positive.expected_behavior: Return spend, conversions, and efficiency for the demo workspace's connected Meta and Google accounts over the prior week, citing tool results. Do not invent metrics.

positive.prompt: Which campaigns drove the most conversions last week?
positive.expected_behavior: List campaigns ordered by conversions (or conversion value) with spend context from the connected Google Ads account.

positive.prompt: Summarize what changed in my ad accounts recently.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize recent Meta/Google change history with associative wording (followed by / associated with), not causal claims.

positive.prompt: How did site traffic look in GA4 over the last 7 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Report sessions/users (or equivalent) for the connected GA4 property for the last 7 complete days.

positive.description: Load a Meta ads diagnostic skill then answer
positive.prompt: Run a Meta ads diagnostic for last week and highlight creative or learning-phase issues.
positive.expected_behavior: Load the meta-ads-diagnostic skill guidance, then answer with evidence from Meta tools. Stay read-only.

negative.prompt: Create a new Meta campaign and set it live with a $500 daily budget.
Delete all underperforming Google Ads campaigns.

negative.description: Refuse access outside the connected workspace
negative.prompt: Show me another customer's Meta ad account that is not connected to this workspace.
